nate.cs: Heads-up: Reef reserved capacity dry-run tomorrow 07:00 PT. Goal: validate quota priming and autoscale wobble handling before Friday go-live. Need owners for load, quotas, and observability.

anya.ops: I'll do quotas + pool prep. Pool id is 'reef-resv-02' per contract. Will pre-warm 4 replicas and set burst_headroom=2.

mike.eng: I'll run the k6 harness. Plan: 10m priming (top-12 prompts), 15m steady at 50 RPS, 2m spike to 200 RPS, 10m soak. Will run staging first.

lina.q: Obs: I'll create dashboard and truth probe. Alerts: p95>500ms, errors>1%. Also will sample 50 responses during spike for quality check.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: reef-reserved-dryrun 2024-04-10 07:00-08:30 PT. Reminder 60m prior.

nate.cs: Priming detail: run prefix heat for 12 minutes before switching to steady. Use model `dialogue-6b-quant`. Header to target reserved pool: x-reserved-pool: reef-resv-02.

mike.eng: k6 snippet I'll use: `k6 run --vus 120 --duration 2m --env TARGET_URL=https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate` plus staged script for full run. Will post artifacts after.

anya.ops: Rollback: instant traffic shift to shared-hosted lane + scale reserved pool down if p95>700ms for >90s. I'll open temp channel #reef-dryrun-ops.

nate.cs: Capture enablement notes: customer asked for a one-page warmup cadence recommendation and token budgeting examples. Mike/Lina can you add to onboarding doc post-run?

lina.q: Yep, will add the 1-pager and attach sample outputs.

mike.eng: I'll take notes and upload k6 results + traces within 1 hour of finish.

nate.cs: Thanks all. Post smoke updates later tonight. If issues, ping @escalations.
